sources.title: UK National Archives, The independence of Bangladesh in 1971
sources.note: Indexed original educational resource, background and numbered original documents. Direct HTML fetch failed and large parallel PDF not inspected. Avoid its imprecise description of 7 March as the declaration of independence; use 26 March instead.

sources.title: Asiatic Society of Bangladesh, Banglapedia: Language Movement
sources.note: Indexed original article, 1948 beginning and 21 February 1952 police killings. Language movement concerns Bangla political recognition, not proof every inhabitant has the same mother tongue.

sources.title: Rafiqul Islam, Banglapedia: War of Liberation, The
sources.note: Full indexed original opening and final Dhaka surrender paragraphs. Direct redirected page sometimes Hello World placeholder. Query site:en.banglapedia.org "War of Liberation" "16 December" "26 March" reproduces witness.

sources.title: Bangladesh Parliament, 2017 bulletin: Political history of Bangladesh
sources.note: Indexed original PDF section Political history of Bangladesh, 1972 institutions, 1975 coups and 1991 parliamentary restoration. Do not repeat its partisan rhetoric or imply an uninterrupted democratic era after 1991.

sources.title: Bangladesh Ministry of Law, Constitution in Bangla, Part I, Articles 3 and 4
sources.note: Direct official consolidated Bangla text, Article3 exact sample প্রজাতন্ত্রের রাষ্ট্রভাষা বাংলা৷. Modern official digital reproduction of 1972 constitutional provision, not a photographed original manuscript.

sources.title: Bangladesh Ministry of Law, Constitution in English, Part I
sources.note: Direct official English counterpart, Article3 state language and Article4 national emblem. Same underlying work as Bangla edition; combined budget. Simplified Latin reading supplied editorially, not quoted as a scholarly transliteration.

sources.title: UNESCO, Traditional art of Jamdani weaving, inscription 00879 (2013)
sources.note: Indexed original full description: discontinuous weft, fine cotton, home workshops and associated crafts; inscription year is documentation, not origin of the craft.

sources.title: UNESCO, Traditional art of Shital Pati weaving of Sylhet, inscription 01112 (2017)
sources.note: Indexed original full description: murta strips, domestic functions, gendered division of work, family learning. Regional tradition, not a universal household practice.

sources.title: FAO GIAHS, Bangladesh floating garden agricultural practices
sources.note: Direct GIAHS description: Gopalganj, Pirojpur and Barisal; dhap layers and vegetable species, seasonal compost reuse. Omit promotional productivity and universal empowerment claims.

sources.title: International Labour Organization, Improving working conditions in the ready made garment industry: Progress and achievements (2015/2016)
sources.note: Indexed full original report, section A key sector for Bangladesh, explicitly 2013 to 14 export figures. Historical figures, not current statistics.

sources.title: International Labour Organization, Bangladesh: Improving safety in the garment industry (17 January 2018)
sources.note: Indexed original first-person workplace reporting, Rana Plaza and inspection, chemical storage and training. Avoid exact conflicting death counts in ILO publications and do not claim all factories now safe.

sources.title: Eyes on the Prize: Lessons from the Cholera Wars for Modern Scientists, Physicians, and Public Health Officials (2013)
sources.note: Indexed original scholarly historical review, paragraph beginning During1902 to 1963 and Dhaka1968 study. Direct PMC access captcha. Query site:pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3795088 "1968" "oral". No treatment recipe or sole-national-invention claim.

sources.title: BRAC, Our history
sources.note: Indexed original organizational history: Sulla1972 rehabilitation and 1980s oral therapy extension. Do not repeat unsupported direct attribution of national mortality reduction to one program.

sources.title: BRAC Education Programme, programme history
sources.note: Indexed original educational programme history: 1985 launch with22 one-room schools, three-year primary programme and disadvantaged children, especially girls.

sources.title: UNICEF Bangladesh, Meena and UNICEF
sources.note: Full indexed primary programme account: fictional9-year-old, Raju, Mithu,1993 Count Your Chickens broadcast and consultation with over10000children. Distinguish fictional adventures from observed historical family.

sources.title: UNICEF Bangladesh, A toilet to be proud of (5 April 2022)
sources.note: Direct full report about Eti and Ziarul Sardar in Monohorpur, Satkhira; upgraded rings/slab/water seal, moved nearer house, cost3300taka paid in instalments. Family health impressions omitted as untested causal claims.

sources.title: UNICEF Bangladesh, School girls in Bangladesh learn that periods are nothing to be ashamed of (9 June 2022)
sources.note: Indexed original account of Labonno and Pirojpur school: hygiene corner, free pads and honesty shop. No claim that facilities cover every school or that attendance improvements establish causation.

sources.title: Bangladesh Red Crescent Society, Cyclone Preparedness Programme
sources.note: Full indexed primary operational history: programme1972, joint government arrangementJuly1973, warnings, evacuation, shelter and first aid. Do not repeat fluctuating current volunteer totals as timeless facts.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Only exact indexed Bangladesh record. Do not alias Bengal, British Raj or Pakistan.
